validity.researcher_notes: gem.wiki returned 403 (Cloudflare) as noted for this scope, so there was no cited source to re-check; all 7 ref cells for this row (Status, Fuel, PipelineType, Length, Diameter, Location, Owner) came back MISSING_REF -- this is fresh research, not re-verification. EXISTENCE/SPEC: SNGPL's own Annual Report lists a 'TRANSMISSION SYSTEM' asset table (SR.#, SECTION, DIA (inches), MAIN LINE (km), LOOP LINE (km)). Row 79 of the FY2016-17 report reads 'SAHIWAL - LAHORE | 18 | 142.93 | -' -- an EXACT match to GEM's Diameter=18in and LengthKnown=142.93km, correctly recorded as a MAIN LINE (not a loop). I independently re-downloaded the exact cited PDF myself and ran pdftotext -layout on it (rather than relying solely on the sheet-cited value) and reproduced the identical line at the same row number. The same line item (same name, same diameter, same length to 2 decimals) recurs identically in SNGPL's FY2014-15, FY2015-16, and FY2017-18 annual reports too (checked all four), so this is not a one-year data-entry artifact. CLASSIFICATION: correct -- the line sits explicitly under SNGPL's own 'TRANSMISSION SYSTEM' section, matching PipelineType=transmission. ATTRIBUTION: Owner1=Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Ltd (SNGPL) 100% is definitionally correct -- SNGPL is the publisher of the table listing this as its own asset. StartLocation=Sahiwal/EndLocation=Lahore matches the line's own name 'SAHIWAL - LAHORE' in the source. DUPLICATE CHECK vs the 63-row roster: the SAME SNGPL table separately lists 'SAHIWAL - LAHORE | 16 | - | 76.67' as a LOOP LINE at a different row number in the same table -- an exact match to roster row P4140 'Sahiwal-Lahore Gas Pipeline-II' (16in/76.67km). So P4108 (main line, 18in, 142.93km) and P4140 (its loop line, 16in, 76.67km) are two distinct, separately-documented physical pipes on the same corridor, not a duplicate/relabel of each other -- GEM's split matches SNGPL's own main/loop distinction. Also checked P4105 'AV29-Sahiwal Gas Pipeline' (145.46km/36in, the preceding segment feeding INTO Sahiwal from the south) and P4124 'Sahiwal-Akhtar Abad Gas Pipeline' (66.69km/24in, a different destination out of Sahiwal) -- both are separate, correctly distinct corridors in the same source table, not overlapping with P4108. CORROBORATION CAVEAT: I found two further corroborating leads I could NOT cite because I could not get a live, fetchable URL for either (both blocked, not fabricated): (1) OGRA's 'State of the Regulated Petroleum Industry 2019-20' report lists a coarser regulatory segment 'AV29 - Sahiwal - Lahore' with a measured capacity utilization of 76-89% as of June 2019/2020, independently confirming real gas flow on this corridor at the corridor level, but ogra.org.pk is behind a Cloudflare wall that 403's every automated fetch (curl and WebFetch alike) and I could not locate a working mirror/Wayback link for the specific report in the time available. (2) A 2006 PSIG (Pipeline Simulation Interest Group) conference paper (PSIG 0602, Lone & Spiers, 'Gas Transmission Development Strategy - a modeling approach') independently describes 'Sahiwal and a 16-inch looped with an 18-inch pipeline transmits gas from the Sahiwal off-take to Lahore' -- matching P4108 (18in) + P4140 (16in loop) as a pair, and pre-dating the annual reports by ~10 years (temporal corroboration of long-term existence) -- but the paper is paywalled on OnePetro (403) and I could not find an open, fetchable copy to cite. Because neither could be verified live, I am not counting them toward the 2-independent-source bar and am not listing them as proposed_refs (no fabricated URLs per standing rule 2) -- flagging them here as leads for a future pass rather than citations. Net effect: tier=medium (one exact, verified, authoritative primary source: the asset owner's own current+historical register, reproduced across 4 separate annual reports) rather than high; nothing here is a data error, hallucination risk, or misclassification -- 'caveat' reflects the corroboration tier only.

summary: P4108 confirmed real, correctly classified transmission main line, not a duplicate of P4140 (its own loop line) -- exact length/diameter match (18in/142.93km) in SNGPL's own transmission asset table across 4 annual reports (2015-2018), verdict=confirmed (caveat), tier=medium (single strong primary source; OGRA + a 2006 PSIG paper corroborate but had no live citable URL). No UNRESOLVED items.
